# telnyx_voice_clone (Resource)

A voice clone, usable as a text-to-speech voice, made either from a voice design or from a recording of a voice. A recording with different content creates a new clone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_voice_design" "example" {
  name   = "Calm narrator"
  prompt = "A calm, warm voice with a slight British accent."
  text   = "Thanks for calling. How can I help you today?"
}

# A clone of a voice design.
resource "telnyx_voice_clone" "designed" {
  name            = "Calm narrator"
  voice_design_id = telnyx_voice_design.example.id
  language        = "en"
  gender          = "female"
}

# A clone of a recording of a real voice.
resource "telnyx_voice_clone" "recorded" {
  name       = "Founder"
  audio_path = "${path.module}/founder.wav"
  language   = "en"
  gender     = "male"

  voice_provider = "telnyx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gender` (String) Gender of the voice clone. One of `female`, `male`, `neutral`.
- `name` (String) Name of the voice clone.

### Optional

- `audio_path` (String) Path to a recording of the voice to clone (WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG or M4A, at most 20 MiB), uploaded when the clone is created. Set this or `voice_design_id`.
- `label` (String) Voice style description. If not explicitly set on upload, falls back to the source design's prompt text.
- `language` (String) Language code of the voice clone (ISO 639-1, or the Resemble catalogue code such as `en-US`).
- `model_id` (String) TTS model identifier for the voice clone. One of `Bayan`, `Pro`, `Qwen3TTS`, `Turbo`, `Ultra`, `Urdu`, `speech-2.8-turbo`.
- `ref_text` (String) Optional transcript of the audio file. Providing this improves clone quality. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `voice_design_id` (String) The voice design to clone. Set this or `audio_path`.
- `voice_provider` (String) Voice synthesis provider used for this clone. One of `Minimax`, `Resemble`, `Telnyx`, `minimax`, `resemble`, `telnyx`.

### Read-Only

- `audio_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the uploaded recording.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the voice clone was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the voice clone.
- `provider_supported_models` (List of String) List of TTS model identifiers supported by this clone's provider.
- `provider_voice_id` (String) Provider-specific voice identifier used for TTS synthesis. May differ from the clone UUID depending on the provider and model.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the resource type.
- `source_voice_design_id` (String) UUID of the source voice design. `null` for upload-based clones.
- `source_voice_design_version` (Number) Version of the source voice design used. `null` for upload-based clones.
- `status` (String) Clone status. pending for Ultra clones while on-prem import is in progress, active once ready, failed if verification timed out, expired if not kept alive.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the voice clone was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_voice_clone.example <id>
```
